Bilingual Education Through Music, Art & Creative Learning

For over 25 years, GoCreative Programs has helped children, families, schools, libraries, and communities learn through bilingual music, art, movement, storytelling, and hands-on creative experiences.

We create engaging English-Spanish programs that inspire language development, creativity, confidence, cultural connection, and joyful learning.

Programs For:

• Schools & Early Childhood Centers
• Libraries & Museums
• Park Districts & Community Events
• Family Programs & Concerts
• Professional Development Workshops

OUR MISSION

GoCreative Programs’ mission is to foster community through bilingualism and the arts, in collaboration with artists, educators, parents, businesses and organizations that share our mission. 

our vision

Our vision is to be the leading organization trusted by libraries, school districts, festivals, artists, nonprofits, businesses, and communities nationwide for delivering exceptional bilingual programs through art and music.

We look forward to working with you and making our bilingual world a better one everywhere we go!

What Your Child Is Building

MúsicaBaby is intentionally designed to develop real language—not simply exposure to another language.

Bilingual Language Development

Through live music, movement, repetition, books, conversation and creative experiences, children develop:

  • Spanish and English vocabulary

  • Listening comprehension

  • Expressive language confidence

  • Responsive communication

  • Familiarity with everyday bilingual phrases

We aren't simply singing songs. We use music and creativity as tools for building usable language.

Early Literacy Foundations

Songs, stories, rhythm and repetition naturally reinforce:

  • Rhythm and rhyme

  • Sound recognition

  • Vocabulary development

  • Listening and attention

  • Story and language comprehension

These experiences help establish the early foundations children will later use for reading and communication.

Movement, Creativity & Exploration

Young children learn by doing.

MúsicaBaby uses movement, instruments and purposeful play to encourage participation and discovery. In MúsicaBaby CREATE, children take the next step through sensory-rich process art experiences that encourage experimentation, fine-motor development, decision-making and creative expression.

Preschool Readiness

Our predictable class structure introduces children to many of the routines they will encounter in preschool:

  • Circle-time participation

  • Musical transitions

  • Turn-taking

  • Following simple directions

  • Listening and responding

  • Self-regulation through rhythm and movement

  • Creating alongside other children

Playful doesn't mean unstructured. Every part of the experience has a purpose.

Where the GoCreative Learning Journey Begins

MúsicaBaby isn't a stand-alone class.

It is where the GoCreative learning journey begins.

What started more than 25 years ago as VamosTodos – Spanish Through Art & Music grew into the educational approach behind GoCreative Programs™ today. MúsicaBaby brings that experience to children during some of their most important years for language, social-emotional development and creative discovery.

As children grow, their GoCreative experiences grow with them:

MúsicaBaby™
Music · Movement · Language · Literacy

↓

MúsicaBaby CREATE™
Music · Language · Literacy · Process Art

↓

CreativeTurtles™ + Bilingual STEAM Explorers
Art · Language · Exploration

From the first song to the first painting, experiment and big idea, the goal remains the same:

Learn. Sing. Create.™

The Music Travels Beyond the Classroom

Many of the songs used in MúsicaBaby were developed inside real classrooms to reinforce bilingual vocabulary through rhythm, repetition and melody.

Those songs eventually grew beyond the classroom into recordings and live performances. Happy Land is Tierra Feliz was produced by Grammy-winning children's music producer Dean Jones and was recognized by Billboard among Latin children's music releases. Today, that classroom-tested music also powers our Being Bilingual Rocks!™ concerts for schools, libraries and communities.

Ready to Begin?

Whether your child is discovering music and language for the first time or is ready to add paint, collage and creative exploration, there's a place to begin.

MúsicaBaby™ — Wednesdays 9 AND 10 AM
MúsicaBaby CREATE™ — Thursdays 10 AM

Come learn, sing and create with us.

Space is limited. Contact us to reserve your child's spot.

We provide Concerts and Creative Bilingual Experiences Nationwide for Libraries, Preschools, School Districts, Festivals, Park Districts, Corporate Events, and More.

GoCreative Programs was founded with one mission:

To make bilingual learning meaningful, artistic, interactive, and accessible for all children and families.

Led by Mi Amigo Hamlet - Alina Celeste and collaborating artists and educators, our programs combine music, process-based art, movement, storytelling, sensory experiences, and creative play into immersive educational experiences that children genuinely remember.

For more than two decades, we have served schools, cultural institutions, libraries, park districts, early childhood programs, and communities across the United States through live performances, residencies, workshops, curriculum-based programming, and family engagement experiences.

Our methodology encourages children to:

• Learn through creativity

• Participate actively

• Build language naturally

• Explore culture through the arts

• Strengthen social-emotional connections

• Develop confidence and curiosity

Introducing the BBR Band, where the magic of Being Bilingual Rocks! comes ALIVE!

Helmed by nationally renowned Parents Choice Award Winners and recording artists, Mi Amigo Hamlet and Alina Celeste, this dynamic ensemble is further enriched by the musical prowess of GRAMMY® nominated Chicago music producer, Richard Rankin, and the soulful blues rock guitar skills of Leo Walsh.

Together, they craft a captivating tapestry of music, seamlessly blending original compositions with traditional songs from Latin America.

The BBR Band invites families on an enchanting musical odyssey, fusing Latin rhythms, bossanova vibes, rumba-flamenco grooves, contemporary Caribbean beats, and a touch of blues rock and bluegrass flavors. Get ready to be immersed in a diverse and electrifying sonic experience that transcends boundaries and celebrates the beauty of bilingualism!

our current workshops

Art with Families: What Will You Create Today?

In this two-part art and music program, we integrate an art project into a music concert, using the creation of visual art

as a vehicle for learning and practicing Spanish while also making music as a community.

Art & Music Story Hour

A workshop for famiilies incorporating musical story time based on a picture book, a related art project, songs and games.

Literacy skills are taught through three mediums: music, reading and visual art where everyone leaves with unique creations!

Arts Español Video Series

In this series, we work together on a variety of art projects that include mixed media techniques, songs, poems, STEM concepts, literacy skills, and cultural exploration. Each program is customized to your needs, but always includes learning and practicing relevant Spanish vocabulary.

These videos can be uploaded to your library Youtube channel, or other Social Media platforms, or closed circuit television networks. We offer licensing agreements and bespoke content.

Paper Mosaic

In this creative bilingual workshop, kids and families come together, using mosaic techniques with paper, encouraging math literacy through working with simple patterns to build unique works of art.

blocks.html:
BIOS


Alina Celeste and Mi Amigo Hamlet are both Parents' Choice Gold Award Winners for their bilingual music for kids and families. 

Guatemalan born and multimedia artist, Hamlet (Mi Amigo Hamlet) has provided bilingual arts and music programs in the Chicagoland area since 2001. His debut album, "Happy Land is Tierra Feliz," not only resonated with families but also garnered critical acclaim, earning a spot in Billboard’s Best Latin Albums for kids in 2018 – a testament to his ability to connect with audiences across generations and cultures.

Cuban-American Alina Celeste has taught early childhood music and arts classes and toured internationally since 2009, her YouTube Channel was launched in 2015 and won a Parent’s Choice Gold Award in 2018. Her ability to blend education with entertainment has made her a beloved figure in the world of children's music.

Together, as GoCreative Programs they tour nationwide, providing their joyous, inclusive Being Bilingual Rocks! concert series, Professional Development workshops for educators and librarians, and engaging Art workshops for families, making learning a joyous and inclusive experience.

Their discography, featuring four bilingual albums – "Happy Land Is Tierra Feliz," "Love is Te Quiero," "Today is a Good Day," and "Hoy es un Buen Día" – is a treasure trove of multicultural melodies, available on platforms like Spotify, Apple Music, and Amazon Music.

They were honored as Jubilation Foundation fellows in 2020 and they were recognized as “Helpers” by the Parents’ Choice Foundation for their invaluable contribution of daily, live, bilingual classes on YouTube and Instagram, bringing learning and joy into homes during a time of uncertainty.
